name: CSC148H1 — Socratic Discovery (Abstract Data Types and Data Structures)
description: An Abstract Data Type (ADT) is defined by its OPERATIONS, not its implementation. Stack: push, pop, peek, is_empty. Queue: enqueue, dequeue. List: get

steps.template_en: An Abstract Data Type (ADT) is defined by its OPERATIONS, not its implementation. Stack: push, pop, peek, is_empty. Queue: enqueue, dequeue. List: get, set, insert, delete. Multiple implementations can satisfy the SAME ADT — with different tradeoffs.
steps.template_zh: 抽象数据类型(ADT)由其操作定义，不由实现定义。栈：push、pop、peek、is_empty。队列：enqueue、dequeue。多种实现可满足相同ADT——各有不同的权衡。

steps.template_en: Stack ADT: operations = push(item), pop()→item, peek()→item, is_empty()→bool. Array implementation: O(1) push/pop (amortized). Linked list: O(1) push/pop. Both implement the SAME ADT. Why use one over the other? Array: better cache locality. Linked: no resizing overhead.
steps.template_zh: 栈ADT：数组实现：push/pop O(1)（分摊）。链表：push/pop O(1)。为什么选一个？数组：更好缓存局部性。链表：无调整大小开销。

steps.template_en: Python list uses a DYNAMIC array (like ArrayList). When full: allocate 2× size, copy. Appending is amortized O(1). But inserting at beginning is O(n) — because all elements must shift. This is why deque from collections import deque for O(1) append/pop from BOTH ends.
steps.template_zh: Python列表用动态数组。满时分配2×大小并复制。尾部添加分摊O(1)。但头部插入是O(n)——所有元素需移位。这就是为什么用collections.deque可以从两端O(1)添加/弹出。

steps.template_en: Implementation tradeoffs: (1) ArrayStack: O(1) push/pop at end, O(n) insert at front. (2) LinkedStack: O(1) push/pop at front, O(n) access by index. (3) ArrayQueue (circular): O(1) enqueue/dequeue, fixed capacity. (4) LinkedQueue: O(1) enqueue/dequeue, dynamic.
steps.template_zh: 实现权衡：(1)数组栈：尾部O(1)压入/弹出，头部O(n)插入。(2)链表栈：头部O(1)压入/弹出，按索引访问O(n)。(3)循环数组队列：O(1)入队/出队，固定容量。(4)链表队列：O(1)入队/出队，动态。

steps.template_en: Implement: (1) Stack using Python list. (2) Queue using two stacks (amortized O(1)). (3) Deque using doubly linked list. (4) Time each operation with timeit — compare list.pop(0) vs deque.popleft(). Which is faster and why?
steps.template_zh: 实现：(1)用Python列表实现栈。(2)用两个栈实现队列（分摊O(1)）。(3)用双向链表实现双端队列。(4)用timeit计时每个操作——比较list.pop(0) vs deque.popleft()。哪个更快？为什么？

steps.template_en: 'Program to an interface, not an implementation.' The ADT separates WHAT from HOW. Your code should depend on the ADT — swapping implementations should not break it. This is ENCAPSULATION and the foundation of modular software design.
steps.template_zh: '面向接口编程，而非实现。'ADT将什么与如何分离开。代码应依赖ADT——切换实现不应破坏它。这就是封装和模块化软件设计的基础。
